title: Product Certification Scheme for use of ISI Mark
purpose: To provide BIS licence for manufacturers to use the Standard Mark (ISI Mark) on products conforming to applicable Indian Standards.
applicable_for: Products covered under mandatory BIS certification requirements
Products notified under Quality Control Orders (QCOs)
Products where manufacturers voluntarily seek BIS certification

marking.description: A unique licence number issued by BIS to identify certified manufacturers and products.

process_steps.title: Identify Applicable Indian Standard
process_steps.description: Determine the applicable IS standard for the product based on product category, specifications and intended use.

process_steps.title: Check QCO Applicability
process_steps.description: Verify whether the product standard is covered under a Quality Control Order and whether BIS certification is mandatory.

process_steps.title: Submit BIS Licence Application
process_steps.description: Manufacturer submits application details including product information, factory details and required documents.

process_steps.title: Product Testing
process_steps.description: Product samples are tested according to the applicable Indian Standard requirements through BIS recognised laboratories.

process_steps.title: Factory Inspection
process_steps.description: BIS officer evaluates manufacturing infrastructure, production process, testing facilities and quality control systems.

process_steps.title: Sample Evaluation
process_steps.description: Test reports and inspection findings are reviewed by BIS for compliance verification.

process_steps.title: Grant of Licence
process_steps.description: After successful evaluation, BIS grants the licence allowing use of the ISI Mark.

process_steps.title: Surveillance
process_steps.description: BIS performs periodic surveillance activities including factory visits and market surveillance to ensure continued compliance.

manufacturer_requirements: Required testing facilities or access to recognised laboratories
Compliance with applicable Indian Standard requirements

validity.renewal: Licence renewal required as per BIS guidelines

title: Product Certification Scheme for Grant of Certificate of Conformity
purpose: To provide Certificate of Conformity for products where this scheme is applicable instead of a regular BIS licence.

process_steps.title: Identify Applicable Standard
process_steps.description: Determine the relevant Indian Standard and conformity requirements.

process_steps.title: Submit Application
process_steps.description: Applicant submits required details and technical information.

process_steps.title: Assessment and Testing
process_steps.description: BIS evaluates product compliance through assessment and testing.

process_steps.title: Grant of Certificate
process_steps.description: Certificate of Conformity is issued after successful verification.

mandatory.description: Certification is compulsory when a product is covered under a Quality Control Order.
mandatory.next_action: Manufacturer must obtain BIS certification before selling the product.

voluntary.description: Manufacturer may voluntarily apply for BIS certification to demonstrate product quality.
voluntary.next_action: Manufacturer can apply through the applicable certification scheme.
